text: The Beginner project's scheduled refresh just worked, because a plain SQL Server connector lets the Power BI Service run the query directly, with no extra setup.
This project's data source is a Python script. The Service is a cloud product with no Python runtime, and it cannot execute an arbitrary local script on its own.

The real fix is a Personal Gateway, a small application installed on a real machine that has Python and pandas actually installed. The Service doesn't run the script itself. It tells the gateway to run it, on that machine, on schedule.

Install the gateway on a Python-ready machine, sign in with the publishing account, select that gateway in the dataset's Gateway connection settings, then turn on Scheduled Refresh. Skipping this produces a refresh that fails outright, not a subtle bug.
With the refresh actually working, next lesson covers a different kind of problem: the Sales Director reports two pages that don't agree.
